geometryRendered.method: the 2x screenshots; a pixel is the figure when its colour is farther from the slot's backing (or the canvas behind a transparent backing) than half the tan bill's distance; CSS px of the 32 px slot

landingRendered.method: Chrome screenshots of the newest avatar's slot in the scripted sequence (light and dark), at device scales 1, 2 and 4, at the hop's last tick, the first rest tick and a later rest tick; pixels compared exactly. The control pair crosses a change of drawing (hop 21 to 22); stillVsAtlas forces the rest to the still file at the first rest tick (window.__kiwiRestSource). Box and centroid: the figure's pixels (farther from the slot's dominant colour than half the tan bill's distance), ink-weighted, in CSS px

rasterNoise.note: exact counts, light and dark at device scales 1, 2 and 4: Chrome's raster can vary an anti-aliased pixel by 1/255 between repaints of an unchanged frame (the captures are taken inside the viewport, where this is rare; beyond it, it reached 45 to 63 pixels), so a change is counted beyond 1/255

stillVsAtlasSweep.method: the still file against the atlas cell in the sequence's newest light slot, shifted by 64 sub-pixel offsets (eighths of a CSS px in x and y), CSS px

figureInSlot.method: the figure (as in landingRendered) in one slot over time, against that slot's own rest drawn from the hop atlas's cell 23: the sequence's newest avatar for the run and the hop, the like exhibit's avatar for the wave; device scales 1, 2 and 4, light and dark; CSS px
